```yaml
name: Update Requests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-requests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          extensions: mbstring, intl, pdo_mysql
          coverage: none

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --no-suggest

      - name: Run PHPStan
        run: |
          vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --level=7 src/

      - name: Run PHPUnit tests
        run: |
          vendor/bin/phpunit --verbose

      - name: Run Behat tests
        run: |
          vendor/bin/behat --strict --format=progress

      - name: Check for ANSI code stripping implementation
        run: |
          # Verify the fix is implemented by checking for relevant code patterns
          if grep -r "strip_ansi_codes\|pager.*color\|decolorize" src/; then
            echo "ANSI code stripping implementation found"
          else
            echo "ERROR: ANSI code stripping implementation not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate regex pattern
        run: |
          # Check that regex properly handles full paths and Windows backslashes
          if grep -r "\\\\[^]]" src/ | grep -v "test"; then
            echo "Regex pattern validation passed"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Regex pattern validation failed"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify Behat tests for pagers
        run: |
          # Ensure Behat tests cover the required scenarios
          if find features/ -name "*.feature" -exec grep -l "pager\|cat\|more" {} \; | wc -l > 0; then
            echo "Behat tests for pagers found"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Behat tests for pagers not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
```
